description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Codex/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: Harden wildcard CORS credentials
userStories.story: As a Weave operator exposing OSv2 APIs through browser clients, I want wildcard CORS responses to avoid credential headers so public development origins do not create an invalid or misleading browser security contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Given CORSMiddleware is configured with allowedOrigins ["*"], when a request includes any Origin header, then the response includes Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
Given CORSMiddleware is configured with allowedOrigins ["*"], when a simple or preflight request is handled, then the response does not include Access-Control-Allow-Credentials.
Given CORSMiddleware is configured with an explicit allowed origin, when that origin is used, then Access-Control-Allow-Credentials remains true and Vary: Origin remains present.
Given a disallowed origin, when a request is handled, then no Access-Control-Allow-Origin or credentials headers are emitted.

userStories.title: Bound rate-limit bucket growth
userStories.story: As a Weave API operator, I want endpoint rate-limit buckets to expire when inactive so long-running OSv2 services are not vulnerable to unbounded limiter growth from high-cardinality IP, user, or ontology keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a rate-limit rule receives requests from many distinct keys, then inactive limiter buckets can be pruned after a configurable idle window.
Given a key remains active, then pruning does not remove its limiter or reset its quota unexpectedly.
Given the default middleware constructor is used, then existing rate-limit behavior remains unchanged except for safe cleanup.

userStories.title: Preserve audit query bounds on bad pagination tokens
userStories.story: As a security administrator reviewing OSv2 audit events, I want invalid admin audit page tokens to fail clearly instead of silently falling back to an unbounded first page.
acceptanceCriteria: Given /api/v2/admin/auditEvents receives a malformed pageToken, then the handler returns a 400-class JSON error.
Given a valid pageToken is supplied, then pagination behavior remains unchanged.
Given no pageToken is supplied, then the first page behavior remains unchanged.

userStories.title: Command Palette Ontology Workspace Routes
userStories.story: As an operator working inside an ontology, I want the global command palette to expose the same ontology-scoped workspace routes as the sidebar so I can jump between Query Builder, Quiver, Import, Approvals, action history, jobs, QueryTypes, automation, proposals, and admin surfaces without leaving keyboard flow.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the command palette is open with activeOntology set to northwind
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator searches for ontology-scoped page labels such as Query Builder, Quiver TS, Import Data, Object Types, or Security Policies
acceptanceCriteria.then: the palette lists those page options and selecting one navigates to the matching /objectsets, /quiver, /import, /admin, or related ontology-scoped route for northwind

acceptanceCriteria.given: the command palette is open with no active ontology
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator searches for ontology-scoped page labels
acceptanceCriteria.then: those ontology-scoped routes are not listed because they cannot resolve safely without an ontology

userStories.title: Frontend Runbook Replaces Vite Boilerplate
userStories.story: As a contributor dogfooding the browser UX, I want web/README.md to document the real Weave Web UI routes, test commands, and E2E setup instead of the stock Vite template so local verification is repeatable.

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Web README describes Weave UI workflows
acceptanceCriteria.when: they look for setup, test, and E2E instructions
acceptanceCriteria.then: the README documents npm install/test/build, make e2e-up, Playwright BDD locations, and the primary Weave OSv2-facing UI surfaces

userStories.title: Dogfood Smoke Route Coverage Stays Discoverable
userStories.story: As a release verifier, I want the dogfood Playwright discovery contract to include newly critical browser UX smoke specs so route regressions cannot silently fall out of CI listing.

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Dogfood route probes are listed by contract
acceptanceCriteria.then: the contract covers command-palette, sidebar, dashboard, dogfood verify, and empty-state smoke specs that protect browser dogfood paths
